description: This is a server entry point for a Remix web application, handling HTTP requests, detecting bots via user-agent, and streaming server-side rendered HTML responses.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main exported function to handle incoming requests, sets CORS headers, and distinguishes between bot and browser requests.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bots, streams HTML response using React's streaming API.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browsers, streams HTML response similarly.
